description: This file defines the MacroTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing macro definitions within Twig templates.

classes.name: MacroTokenParser
classes.description: Final class responsible for parsing macro definitions in Twig templates, extending AbstractTokenParser.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a macro token, extracts macro name and arguments, and registers the macro in the parser context.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of a macro block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this token parser ('macro').

methods.name: parseDefinition
methods.description: Parses the argument list of the macro, ensuring defaults are constants and constructing the argument list.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Validates that a node only contains constant expressions, used for macro argument defaults.
